CustomField.description: Custom filter conditions evaluated against Case fields during rule matching. Supports AND-combined conditions. Only fields included in the batch query are available.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter conditions combined with AND. Syntax: Field = 'Value', Field != 'Value', Field = null, Field != null, Field LIKE 'Pattern%', Field IN ('A','B'), Field NOT IN ('A','B'), Field = true/false. OR is not supported. Available fields: Id, CaseNumber, Status, Origin, LastModifiedDate, CreatedDate, Owner.Name, LastModifiedBy.Name, RecordType.DeveloperName.
CustomField.label: Additional Filter Logic
